Earl Browder

The current number of the Readers' Digest contains
an article on the American Communist Party wherein the
following reference is made to Earl Browder :-

"The Secretary of the Party - the sub-Stalin of America -
is a man named Earl Browder, who was born 43 Years ago in
Wichitta, Kansas. He is a small, thin-faced, sandy man
with a quiet voice and a quizzical eye - a distinctly
American type. He is a good executive and he knows how
to handle the racial mixture he daily encounters. During
the war he spent two years in Leavenworth for his anti-
War activities. For 18 years he was a certified public
accountant. His second in command is Clarence Hathaway,
big, blue-eyed, ex-machinist from Minnesota, who edits
the official Party organ, the Daily Worker.

SERVICE POLITIQUE
Enregistré le 23 MAY 1935
Sous No. 5558

1935年5月22日。

（印：副本）

厄尔·白劳德 (Earl Browder)

本期《读者文摘》(Readers' Digest) 刊登了一篇关于美国共产党的文章，其中提及厄尔·白劳德如下：

“该党书记——美国的次斯大林——是一位名叫厄尔·白劳德的人，他于43年前出生于堪萨斯州威奇托 (Wichitta)。他身材矮小，面容清瘦，肤色浅黄，声音低沉，眼神带着戏谑——是典型的美国人形象。他是一位干练的管理者，懂得如何应对每日接触到的种族混杂人群。战争期间，他因反战活动而在莱文沃思 (Leavenworth) 服刑两年。他曾担任注册会计师达18年之久。他的副手是克拉伦斯·哈撒韦 (Clarence Hathaway)，来自明尼苏达州，身材高大，蓝眼睛，前机械师，负责编辑党的官方机关报《工人日报》(Daily Worker)。

政治处
